---
title: "Airhouse"
description: "Oxygen's managed warehouse, where your data lands and is queried from"
---

**Airhouse** is Oxygen's managed warehouse, the place where your data lands
and where the [semantic model](/guide/build/semantic-model/simple-model) and
agents query it from. Each workspace gets its own Airhouse tenant, served
over the Postgres wire protocol so that any Postgres-compatible client or BI
tool can connect to it, and access runs on ephemeral credentials minted on
demand, so there is no long-lived key to store or rotate.

Use Airhouse when you want Oxygen to manage the warehouse for you. It is also
where [Airway](/guide/build/data-infrastructure/airway) pipelines land
extracted data and where custom apps append their own facts. If you already
have a warehouse, you do not need Airhouse, since Oxygen
[connects to your own](/guide/build/connect-data) and the semantic model
compiles the same way regardless of where the data lives.
